//: Port of this folder's denver.yml to devbox (https://www.jetify.com/devbox).
Written to spec and NOT executed -- devbox and nix are not installed in the
repo that produced this branch. See ../PORTING-devbox.md for the fidelity
denver original: three 'custom' stages demonstrating stage-to-stage env
propagation, plus one env-specific CLI flag (--greeting).
GAP -- denver's 'args:' declared a real argparse flag (--greeting, default
'hello'), listed by `denver simple-env --help` and delivered as
DENVER_ARG_GREETING. devbox has no per-project CLI argument declaration.
Nearest equivalent: the GREETING default below.
denver's 'set-vars' stage used `source: custom.sh` so the exports fold
into every later stage and the final command. devbox's init_hook runs in
the shell it hands you, so sourcing there is the direct equivalent.
GAP -- 'print-vars-before' demonstrated that the vars are NOT set yet at
that point in the pipeline. init_hook is a single hook, not an ordered
list of stages with observable state between them, so running the
'before' echo here would print the vars as already set and demonstrate
the opposite of what the original does. It is therefore a script below
